Under the direction of the Executive Director of Planned Giving, the Planned Giving Coordinator provides high-level administrative support, project management, and operational coordination to the Executive Director of Planned Giving and the Planned Giving Team. The Planned Giving Coordinator must possess the ability to work collaboratively with advancement colleagues and interact effectively with donors, prospects, professional advisors, trustees, executors, and campus stakeholders. Areas of responsibility include: office management, donor and development officer event coordination, donor stewardship, prospect management, preparation of marketing and other promotional materials, record and database management including research and analysis for the Planned Giving team, and coordination of estate administration activities related to realized planned gifts. This includes assisting with the tracking and documentation of estate distributions, maintaining communication with trustees, executors, attorneys, and family members, coordinating internal review and processing of estate-related gifts and assets, and ensuring donor intent is properly documented and fulfilled in collaboration with University Advancement, legal, finance, the UC Regents, and gift administration partners.
Possess traits of good judgment and discretion in communicating with colleagues and constituents.
May be required to drive on occasion in order to perform the routine or essential job responsibilities for the position.

Proven level of outstanding professionalism in providing executive assistance to supervisor including: scheduling meetings, coordinating all travel and lodging arrangements, liaison to faculty and staff, prioritizing incoming mail, screening telephone calls and general office management
